items.title: /g/ Technology: 12 V logic
items.content_text: I've had a horrible epiphany.  AND and OR circuits with more than 2 inputs normally require exotic chips or wasteful cascades.  A Programmable Logic Device, pic related, will allow any function, of A, B, and C, by using a big OR with and AND of every permutation of A, B, and C.  Here is the epiphany:  You can configure a 555 timer as a Schmitt Trigger Not (Inverter).  This is the backbone of Mickey Mouse Logic: Using only diodes and a couple of resisters to create huge NAND, NOR, AND, OR, etc.
